summary: Seek out this Isan-style meal for the contrast between larb's minced meat and nam tok's grilled meat, tossed with herbs, lime, chilli and toasted rice. An especially practical Ari lead is Phed Phed Lhay: its official branch page links an Ari menu with larb and nam tok choices. The exact December 2026 menu, prices and holiday hours may change.
whyGo: A lively sour, savoury, herbal and crunchy dish with a distinctive toasted-rice aroma; order sticky rice alongside to balance the chilli.
Try both textures: larb is minced meat, while nam tok is commonly grilled sliced meat. The Ari menu also lists grilled chicken and pork chop versions.
bestFor: Travellers keen on Isan food and assertive lime, chilli, herbs and toasted-rice flavours.
A shared meal: add sticky rice and another grilled dish, then compare pork, chicken or beef versions.
skipIf: You need vegetarian, vegan or halal food; the cited dishes are meat-based and the restaurant does not advertise a halal kitchen.
You avoid chilli or fish sauce entirely, or want a mild, plain meal. Ask about ingredients and heat before ordering.
duration: Plan about 45–90 minutes for a meal; this is a planning estimate, not a venue-set duration.
cost: At Phed Phed Lhay's linked menu, pork larb is ฿320 (beef +฿30), grilled chicken nam tok ฿280, and pork chop nam tok ฿350; sticky rice is ฿30. Menu notes say prices include VAT and a 3% service charge is added. These are current menu references, not a December 2026 quote.
hours: Phed Phed lists its Lhay branch in Ari at 10:30–21:30. The page does not specify days, and December holiday hours may differ; check the branch before travelling.
bestTime: Lunch or an early dinner makes this an easy meal stop. Go earlier if you want a particular dish: Phed Phed says menus and daily quantities can vary by branch and some dishes may be limited.
gettingThere: For the sourced Ari example, use Phed Phed Lhay, Soi Sai-Lom 1; its official branch page links a map pin. Take a taxi or ride-hail to the branch, or check the map from BTS Ari for the last leg. Street-level walking conditions and exact travel time are unverified.
booking: Phed Phed says its branches do not accept table reservations. Check the Ari menu link or call the branch before making a special trip, since menus vary across branches and dishes may sell out.
accessibility: The restaurant does not publish accessibility details for Phed Phed Lhay on the cited branch page. Contact the branch about step-free access, seating and restroom needs before visiting.
practicalTips: Useful menu names: ลาบหมูเหนืออีสาน (Isan pork larb; beef is listed as a +฿30 swap), น้ำตกไก่ย่าง (grilled chicken nam tok), and น้ำตกพอร์คชอป (pork chop nam tok).
Isan food can be very spicy. Ask for a mild version if needed, and confirm whether fish sauce or fermented fish is used if you avoid it; preparation can vary.
The linked menu lists sticky rice at ฿30 and says a 3% service charge is added after VAT-inclusive prices.
decemberNotes: No December-only season is indicated for these dishes. The published Ari menu and hours are useful planning leads, but neither guarantees December 2026 availability; recheck the branch close to the visit, especially around holiday dates.
uncertainties: Phed Phed's own site says menus differ between its nine branches and daily portions can be limited; confirm the Ari branch still serves the listed larb and nam tok in December 2026.
The published menu and listed 10:30–21:30 hours may change before the trip; branch days and December holiday hours are not stated.
Accessibility information for Phed Phed Lhay is not published on its branch page.
